_doc: Canonical product-artifact map for generated products (BI-PF-0765): what each doc is, its OWNER agent, its CONSUMERS (who takes it forward), and its phase. Single source of truth; rendered to docs/ARTIFACT-OWNERS.md by scripts/dev/gen_artifact_map.py and kept fresh by a precheck gate. Owners/consumers are validated against core.agent_structure.KNOWN_AGENTS.

artifacts.name: Idea / discovery brief
artifacts.purpose: shaped idea, target users, problem framing that seeds requirements

artifacts.name: PRD (feature-by-feature requirements)
artifacts.purpose: formal product requirements, feature by feature (the PRD)

artifacts.name: Design brief (brand / colors / fonts / screens / typography / UI components)
artifacts.purpose: how every screen should look; visual system + UI components

artifacts.name: UX/IA + app flow (user journeys, navigation, click-to-next-page) + design tokens
artifacts.purpose: key user journeys, information architecture, screen flow, and design tokens (brand/color/font)

artifacts.name: Product plan (feature list + phases + milestones)
artifacts.purpose: the feature list, build order, phases, and milestones

artifacts.name: Implementation plan (what/order/owners + next agent)
artifacts.purpose: what gets built, in what order, phases/milestones, owning agent and the next agent

artifacts.name: Technical requirements / tech stack
artifacts.purpose: tech stack, tools/SDKs, components, integration points

artifacts.name: Data model / schema (entities, storage, access)
artifacts.purpose: data model, where client data lives, who can see it (authorization)

artifacts.name: Feature status
artifacts.purpose: which features are implemented/done (drives review + validation)

artifacts.name: Code review report
artifacts.purpose: findings + verdict (READY FOR VALIDATION / NEEDS FIXES)

artifacts.name: Validation report
artifacts.purpose: test/quality results and pass/fail for the run

artifacts.name: Product documentation
artifacts.purpose: user/developer docs assembled from the artifacts above

artifacts.name: Review focus checklist (production-risk)
artifacts.purpose: the production-risk checklist the code-review agent runs per build iteration (BI-PF-1066)
